title: Making access more intelligent
body: Unattended handoffs used to mean blind trust: no record of who showed up, what changed hands, or whether anything went wrong along the way. Veranda was built to close that gap.

capabilities.label: Authorization
capabilities.title: Give access to only those who need it and only when they need it.

capabilities.label: Auditability
capabilities.title: See everything, from access logs to temperature, air quality, battery levels, and more.

capabilities.label: Automation
capabilities.title: Build schedules, triggers, and alerts that keep things running on their own.

capabilities.label: Integration
capabilities.title: Plug into the apps, systems, and physical products your operation already uses.
